name: Irina Vladimirovna Petrova
bio:
Irina Petrova's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly during her university years. While studying engineering, she volunteered at a local rally event to gain practical experience. The chaotic energy of the pit lane and the precision required in coordinating resources captivated her. After graduation, she started as a junior logistics assistant for a small racing team, meticulously tracking parts and managing inventory. Her keen eye for detail and unwavering commitment to efficiency quickly earned her recognition. 

Irina believes that a well-organized logistics operation is the backbone of any successful racing team. She is known for her rigorous approach, ensuring that every component, tool, and personnel are in the right place at the right time. Her demanding nature stems from a deep-seated belief that complacency leads to costly mistakes. Irina's distinctive touch is her ability to anticipate potential logistical bottlenecks and proactively implement solutions, a skill honed over decades of experience in the demanding world of motorsport. She joined Triple Eight Race Engineering five years ago and has been a key part of their success ever since.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled in a short, practical bob, often with a few strands escaping her control.
physical.description: Irina is a woman of medium build with a perpetually focused expression.

quirks: Insists on using a physical whiteboard alongside digital tracking systems.
Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously jotting down observations.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
